get.summary: Return paginated orders, support ?status= and ?userId= filters

post.summary: Create order, validate that all itemIds exist, set status to pending

get.summary: Return order with full item details joined, 404 if not found

patch.summary: Advance status: pending→processing→shipped→delivered. Reject invalid transitions.

delete.summary: Cancel only if status is pending. Return 409 if already processing or shipped.
